plan.source: First successful local Zebra tip observation; block identity fetched and verified separately.
plan.prep: Earliest successful matching header read by observer or either instrumented writer.
plan.commit: Writer observes successful applyBatch return after PostgreSQL commit acknowledgement.
plan.graphql: First completed coherent GraphQL response with the expected block hash and transaction count.
plan.timing: Same-host process.hrtime.bigint monotonic timestamps. Observation/polling bounds, not exact publication times. Negative stage observations are preserved.
plan.comparison: Same source blocks, schema, handlers, commit/page sizes, database server and shared cgroup. Only polling interval changes; actor assignments cross over after half the samples.
plan.acceptance: All expected entities and restarts pass; full paired sample goal; candidate median Prep-to-GraphQL <=80% baseline and source-to-GraphQL p95 no higher; no probe errors.
plan.failures: Timed readiness gates and writer/control throttling are retained. Finite verification commands alone may retry 429/503 up to five attempts outside live timing; every retry is recorded.
plan.cache: Warm running source and database server, new empty namespaces, bootstrap excluded; no cache clearing.
plan.restart: One graceful and one SIGKILL stop per actor, after acknowledged committed data; no crash injected inside a SQL transaction.

setup_failures.reason: Harness ESM resolution failed before actor setup.
Observer metadata 429 was treated as fatal during bootstrap.
Harness treated a recorded GraphQL read gate as fatal before the first paired sample.

decision: All three studies passed exact entities and restart checks. All proposed shorter polling configurations were rejected by the preregistered zero-error acceptance rule. Production settings were not changed.
sampling_note: Each study has twelve paired new source blocks, two six-block phases with crossed actors. Percentiles use nearest rank; p95 equals the maximum at this sample count. Do not pool studies.
harness_maintenance: Recorded exact sources are attached per study. After successful runs, database teardown received a bounded forced-close repair, covered by a stalled-transport regression test. This does not change the successful sample timing boundaries.
